title: feat(autocomplete): add `transformItems` prop
body:
[FX-3589]

**Summary**
This PR adds a `transformItems` prop to the autocomplete widget which, similarly to other `transformItems`, allows users to update hits/indices being displayed (including reordering with working keyboard navigation).
